params.1273: Craft astral runes at the Astral Altar.
params.1274: Acquire some pure essence, either by mining it or removing it from the wicked hood.
params.1275: Use an astral talisman on the wicked hood so you can enter the altar without the talisman in your inventory.
params.1276: Locate the Astral Altar ruins or teleport to them with the wicked hood.
params.1277: Wearing your wicked hood, click the ruins to enter and click on the altar to craft your runes.
